name: Original Vilverin leveled actor placement from genuine shore checkpoint (ASan/UBSan)

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local age=0
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 age=age+dt;if core.isWorldPaused() or done then return end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x6c2aa,0x6c2ab}}) do local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id));if not obj or not obj:isValid() then return end end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x6c2aa,0x6c2ab}}) do
  local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  assert(obj and obj:isValid(),'Original Vilverin actor absent: '..id)
  print('VilverinPlacement actor='..id..' object='..tostring(obj)..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current)
 end
 print('VilverinPlacement ready health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 done=true
end}}}}
